changelog: Bitfunded Transaction History paste comes in two formats -- margin era (Open Position carries the real margin, Close Position returns margin+PnL with funding already netted out, Funding Fee rows are informational) and zero era (Open Position is 0.0000, Close Position carries only realised PnL, Funding Fee rows move the balance directly). The importer summed every Funding Fee row into the challenge-level funding total regardless of era, double-counting margin-era funding on any ledger spanning both formats -- verified 17.45 overcount on a real ledger.

Fixed in bitfunded_parser.php: era is now detected from the data (a non-zero Open Position Amount), never a hardcoded date. Margin-era Funding Fee rows (at or before the latest margin-era Close's own Time) are excluded from the challenge-level funding total written to challenges.funding_adjustment; zero-era rows are counted exactly as before. Per-trade funding attribution (display-only trades.funding) now branches the same way instead of always using the margin formula.
Import preview now shows an explicit line when funding rows were excluded as margin-era, with the count and total, so the rule applied is visible rather than trusted blind.
Bitfunded Altcoin and every other existing import is unaffected -- a ledger with no non-zero Open Position rows gets a null era cutover and behaves exactly as before this release.
release_notes: No DB migration -- this is parsing logic only (includes/bitfunded_parser.php, js/bfimport.js), no schema change. Self-test (php includes/bitfunded_parser.php, run directly) extended with a dedicated mixed-era fixture plus a zero-era-only backward-compatibility fixture; one pre-existing fixture's own expected funding_total changed from 4.1869 to 0.1441 because that fixture genuinely contains a margin-era position and was itself undercounting the bug before this fix (not a regression -- the old number was the double-counted one). Verified directly against the real ledger this was built for (ledger-15min-entry.txt, 876 rows, Acrob's file, not committed to this repo): cutover 2026-01-26 23:36:16, 201 funding rows excluded (-17.4617), 188 counted (+4.5880), independent balance check 9240.3604 against the ledger's own final balance 9240.3514 (0.009 off, inside the $0.05 tolerance) -- the pre-fix sum would have been 9222.8987. php -l and node --check pass clean on both changed files; duplicate-name scan clean; full tools/ui-harness suite passes (none of this release's changes touch any backtest file).
